A real lazy-load address wins over an inline data src when the payload is not kept

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"inline_data_media\":\"DropElement\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" data-src=\"https://example.com/real.png\" alt=\"icon\"></p>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
